## Large file note

`Game.exe` is reported as 178,946,949 bytes. GitHub rejects ordinary Git files larger than 100 MiB; use Git LFS for this file, or leave it out until we confirm it is needed. See GitHub's [large-file documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/working-with-files/managing-large-files/about-large-files-on-github).
